confidentUnsupported.evidence: it is likely that moisture has tracked underneath the ceramic glass and caused a short circuit in the control electronics

rationale: The assistant misdiagnosed Er03 as moisture under the glass shorting the electronics, and it hinted at PCB damage, which is an unsupported claim. It prescribed an unnecessary 24-48 hour wait, and the second reply still did not just advise trying the hob now that the slider was wiped dry. It never asked whether the code returned once dry or whether anything was resting on the controls. It did avoid recommending a part and gave no unsafe DIY steps. Isolating at the wall and wiping dry was the right core action, so the customer would probably still reach a fix, but with confusion and delay.
